display_name.description: The user's display name. Absent leaves it alone; an explicit `null` clears it.

role.description: The role the user holds from now on, by key. A key that names no role is accepted and grants nothing. The change applies at once: the user's live subscriptions are re-checked against the new role, and those it no longer allows end.
role.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused, and `defaults` is reserved.

status.description: Block the account or let it back in. **`pending_verification` cannot be set here**: it is reached only by self-registration and left only by spending the mailed verification token, so a developer setting it would strand the account in a state nothing re-mails them out of.
